name: Wan 2.2 image-to-video
summary: Open 14B mixture-of-experts video model from Alibaba. Animates a still image into a short clip with strong motion and camera control.

limits.label: Length
limits.note: 5 s at 16 fps; longer clips loop or drift

settings.label: Short edge
settings.why: 720p is much slower; start at 480p and go up for finals

settings.label: Duration
settings.why: The length it was trained on

tips: Describe the motion and the camera, not what's already in the image.
One clear action per clip works better than a sequence of events.
avoid: Text and logos that must stay legible across frames.

examples.title: Slow push-in
examples.prompt: The camera slowly pushes in while the subject turns their head toward the light, soft wind in the hair, natural motion

hardware.note: With fp8 weights and model offloading

gotchas: The workflow needs both high-noise and low-noise expert weights; downloading one gives a black video.
